children: US crude oil and gasoline inventories rose, while distillate stocks fell last week, market sources said on Tuesday, citing data from the American Petroleum Institute.
Crude stocks rose by 1.02 million barrels in the week ended September 25, the sources said, on the condition of anonymity.
Gasoline stocks rose by 2.99 million barrels, while distillate inventories fell by about 286,000 barrels, compared with a week earlier, the sources said.
